text:
Evan B.: Heads-up: Zenova Medical renewal 07/15. Procurement flagged a mismatch between the PO and our invoicing entity and they also want SSO onboarding details before approving the addon. Need quick alignment. :eyes:
Leah M.: What mismatch?
Ravi P.: PO sent to Zenova Health Inc but contract invoices Zenova Medical LLC. PO# ZM-4521. They attached it to the renewal request.
Sophie K.: They want to add 10 seats (current 20 -> 30). Training can do a half-day enablement if we lock a date. They need SSO checklist to sign off.
Evan B.: Sales wants price protect for the 20 seats; add-ons at list. Procurement says they won't approve PO until billing matches.
Leah M.: Fastest path = reissued PO. Backup = one-page invoice-entity amendment via DocuSign (takes ~48 hours with exec sign). @procure-bot any suggested copy?
procure-bot: Suggested buyer message:
```
Please reissue the purchase order naming "Zenova Medical LLC" (EIN: 22-3344556) as the billing entity and reference ZM-4521. If you require a sample invoice or W-9, please let us know and we will provide immediately.
```
Ravi P.: I'll ping the buyer. Also they asked for net60; finance capped at net45.
Sophie K.: We can tentatively reserve an enablement slot the week of 7/11 if PO or amendment confirmed by 7/7. Need final headcount by then.
Evan B.: Plan: request PO reissue today. If buyer can't, prep one-pager amendment, attach prorate in quote, and expedite exec sign. Ravi, ask buyer for PO ETA and whether they need our invoice sample.
Ravi P.: Sent: "Can procurement reissue the PO to Zenova Medical LLC (EIN included)? If not, we'll send a one-page DocuSign amendment to align invoice entity and preserve your enablement slot."
Leah M.: Finance note on prorate for add-on (monthly billing example):
```
10 added seats * $175/seat = $1,750 prorated for the month of July (if add-on effective 7/15 then prorate by days)
```
Evan B.: Add prorate example into the quote and amendment. Also include SSO checklist link for their security team.
procure-bot: DocuSign template queued: AMEND-BILL-ENTITY-1PAGER v4. Will auto-fill EIN and prorate when Leah uploads numbers.
Ravi P.: Buyer replied: procurement can reissue but asked for a sample invoice showing billing EIN and address, plus the SSO checklist to confirm security controls. Requesting PDFs now.
Leah M.: Uploading sample invoice with billing EIN, address, and VAT note. Also attaching SSO checklist and link to our SAML setup doc. Sending to buyer.
Sophie K.: Buyer says procurement will reissue PO by EOD once they receive invoice sample and final headcount. I'll mark enablement slot as "pending PO" and hold it for 48 hours.
Ravi P.: PO reissued and attached: ZM-4521-REISSUED.pdf (billing = Zenova Medical LLC). Forwarding to finance now.
Evan B.: Great. Once finance confirms we can finalize seat add-on and schedule enablement. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Leah M.: Finance confirmed invoice processing ok. Reminder: if amendment had been needed it would have required exec sign. Good to avoid that overhead.
Sophie K.: Locking enablement for 7/12 cohort. Sending calendar invite to buyer and CSM.
Evan B.: Closing loop. Document final quote and PO in SFDC, update renewal status to "processing invoice".
